measurement_rule: Record counterevidence before favourable evidence; never select the success metric after observing results.

experiments.decision_question: Does the reproducible sample path help developers reach a useful first result?
experiments.hypothesis: A task-led sample with one indication, one unresolved fact and one negative makes evaluation easier than feature-list browsing.
experiments.counter_hypothesis: The sample adds reading and clone work without increasing useful evaluation.
experiments.asset: existing examples/cv-screening-app journey; dedicated minimal demonstration repository remains unbuilt
experiments.baseline: No current event-contract baseline; the retained export ended 2026-08-13.
experiments.primary_metric: Install Command Copy per sample-page view, supplemented by observed task completion in moderated research.
experiments.guardrail: Do not alter fixtures or output to manufacture favourable accuracy.
experiments.denominator: Sample-page views in the same exact reporting window.
experiments.minimum_observation: Four weekly readouts or 30 sample-page views, whichever is later; management rule, not a power calculation.
experiments.owner_effort_cap: 4 hours implementation plus 30 minutes per weekly review
experiments.uncertainty: Install-command copy is an intent proxy and does not prove installation or useful output.
experiments.stop_condition: Stop revising the asset after two rounds with no observed task blocker or if no qualified traffic reaches it.

experiments.decision_question: Can a non-technical founder correctly explain the homepage result and its limits?
experiments.hypothesis: The five-question founder-first journey supports correct task completion without implying a legal determination.
experiments.counter_hypothesis: The language remains too dense, or the commercial routes are mistaken for legal conclusions.
experiments.baseline: Mechanical browser checks passed; representative comprehension evidence is zero participants.
experiments.primary_metric: Participants who can explain both what Regula observed and what it did not decide, reported as a count with verbatim failure themes.
experiments.guardrail: Do not coach, use leading satisfaction questions, or treat visual preference as a task failure.
experiments.denominator: All participants who attempt the complete task in the round.
experiments.minimum_observation: Five participants in the first formative round; a design rule, not a population estimate.
experiments.cost_cap: No recruitment spend until controller, notice, consent, storage and retention facts pass the privacy gate.
experiments.uncertainty: A small formative sample identifies usability failures but cannot estimate population conversion.
experiments.stop_condition: Do not recruit while the controller, consent record, storage location or retention period is unresolved.

experiments.decision_question: Does one independent Console.dev review produce qualified developer evaluation?
experiments.hypothesis: Console.dev's developer-tool readership is sufficiently task-aligned to produce scanner, install or integration continuation.
experiments.counter_hypothesis: AI-governance scanning is peripheral to regular developer workflow and produces curiosity traffic only.
experiments.asset: docs/distribution/EDITORIAL-EXECUTION-PACKETS-2026-08-25.md; Console.dev packet with live sample, limitations and finite campaign URL
experiments.baseline: No Console.dev referral recorded in the retained export.
experiments.primary_metric: Scanner Complete plus Install Command Copy from the allowlisted Console campaign, with qualified replies recorded separately.
experiments.guardrail: No sponsored-review implication, uniqueness claim or legal-risk claim.
experiments.denominator: Allowlisted Console campaign sessions in the same exact window.
experiments.minimum_observation: One editorial decision and, if published, four weekly readouts.
experiments.uncertainty: The editor controls publication and Plausible aggregates do not prove individual journeys.
experiments.stop_condition: One follow-up maximum; stop after rejection or 14 days without response.

experiments.decision_question: Does the Article 50 task page attract relevant users who then choose an appropriate next action?
experiments.hypothesis: A cited task answer can introduce qualified non-code users to the free assessment without implying that all generated content is regulated.
experiments.counter_hypothesis: The audience has a content question but no use for code scanning or evidence scaffolds.
experiments.baseline: Fresh Search Console baseline unavailable; retained analytics is pre-contract and low volume.
experiments.primary_metric: Article 50 guide views followed by assessment-page views, reported directionally at aggregate level.
experiments.guardrail: Retain paragraph-specific conditions, exceptions and product limitations; no fear-based deadline copy.
experiments.denominator: Article 50 guide views in the same exact reporting window.
experiments.minimum_observation: 28 days after a verified Search Console baseline exists.
experiments.uncertainty: Aggregate page counts cannot establish a single-user path or search causality.
experiments.stop_condition: Do not add more Article 50 content until the existing page's discovery and continuation can be measured.

experiments.decision_question: Does compliant low-volume outreach produce qualified conversations about code evidence and unresolved deployment facts?
experiments.hypothesis: Recruitment AI vendors recognise a bounded need for technical evidence that questionnaires alone do not provide.
experiments.counter_hypothesis: The problem is adequately handled by counsel, procurement questionnaires or internal engineering without Regula.
experiments.asset: free recruitment-AI guide plus local scanner and reproducible example
experiments.baseline: Zero authorised campaign contacts delivered under this directive.
experiments.primary_metric: Qualified conversations per delivered first contact; price decisions remain a separate later measure.
experiments.guardrail: Corporate recipients only; no personal addresses, no tracking pixels, clear opt-out, suppression check, maximum 10 new recipients per business day.
experiments.denominator: Delivered first contacts, excluding bounces, with bounce count also reported.
experiments.minimum_observation: Stop-segment decision after 30 delivered first contacts.
experiments.owner_effort_cap: Manual review of every message; two follow-ups maximum
experiments.uncertainty: Replies may reflect interest in regulation rather than willingness to use or pay for Regula.
experiments.stop_condition: Stop immediately on objection and stop the segment after 30 delivered first contacts with no qualified response.

experiments.decision_question: Can a governance professional use the evidence scaffold without extensive explanation?
experiments.hypothesis: Traceable observations, missing facts and integrity metadata reduce evidence-organisation work.
experiments.counter_hypothesis: The scaffold creates more review work than it removes or is mistaken for substantive assurance.
experiments.asset: evidence-pack command, sample report, fact store and published limitations
experiments.baseline: No representative professional usability sessions are recorded.
experiments.primary_metric: Task completion and critical explanation requests in a moderated walkthrough.
experiments.guardrail: Never call the output audit-ready, sufficient, certified or a compliance determination.
experiments.denominator: All professionals who attempt the pre-defined evidence-review task.
experiments.minimum_observation: Five formative sessions after the research privacy gate.
experiments.cost_cap: No recruitment spend before privacy gate
experiments.uncertainty: Formative performance does not establish time saved in real engagements.
experiments.stop_condition: Stop if participants consistently require source material or assurance that Regula does not and cannot provide.
